veranderings.voor: Toetankamen (in Engels: Tutankhamun) se graf was vol duisende dinge
veranderings.na: Die graf van Toetankamen (in Engels: Tutankhamun) was vol duisende dinge
veranderings.rede: A possessive 'se' after a bracket reads as if it belongs to the English name; 'die graf van' keeps both protected names intact and reads cleanly.
